scientific_integrity: Exact finite arithmetic, rational arrangement proof of infinite stabilization, no claim of independent review.
scientific_limitations: Prime-order cyclic groups in a named-zero ternary relational addition language at quantifier rank four only; full one-command type replay may require more than short tool execution limits. A published claimed lower bound conflicts with the new exact computation and merits independent review.
